'''Philip T. Metzger''' is an American planetary physicist with the [[Florida Space Institute]].<ref name="Space Institute" /> In 2012 he co-founded [[NASA]]'s [[Swamp Works]],<ref name="Swamp Works" /> and in May 2018 he was honoured with the Outstanding Technical Contribution Award from the [[American Society of Civil Engineers]],<ref name="Contribution Award" /> later that year he worked with [[Honeybee Robotics]] to develop the [[World Is Not Enough (spacecraft propulsion)|WINE spacecraft prototype]].<ref name="WINE prototype" /> Metzger disagrees with the [[IAU definition of a planet]].<ref name="IAU definition" />

A {{convert|4.6|km|mi|abbr=on}} wide [[main-belt asteroid]] discovered on June 1, 2000 at the [[Anderson Mesa Station]] has been named after Metzger: [[36329 Philmetzger]].<ref name="SBDB" />
